# Skeletons
Hidden away in the darkest and most forgotten places of stations, Skeletons find these places the best for taking naps.
They do not need to breathe, do not take damage from the pressure of space, and are not affected by temperature. They cannot ingest chemicals, but are able to be healed by splashing milk upon themself.
## Skeleton Naming Conventions
Skeletons often have names which have a bone related pun for a first name and then a more human-esque last name. - [color=#449944]Acceptable:[/color] Tarsals Fisher - [color=#449944]Acceptable:[/color] Sternum Chapman - [color=#449944]Acceptable:[/color] Radius Menthols - [color=#449944]Acceptable:[/color] Rib Reeds - [color=#994444]Bad:[/color] Sans Undertale - [color=#994444]Bad:[/color] Jim Boner - [color=#994444]Bad:[/color] Skeletor
## Lore
Skeletons hold an odd place as denizens of the stars as their cause is one of the universe's biggest mysteries. Is it the ambient magic of space? A curse upon the sector? The same skeleton on every station with amnesia? This remains a mystery to Skeletons and non-skeletons alike across the galaxy. The only consistent thing that all know of skeletons is the law they hold in their bones, that being: "I do what I want."
